hints.tr: `is_valid` Problem Set 2'deki fonksiyonun aynısı; değişen dosyanın sonu: `main()` yerine `if __name__ == "__main__":` altında `main()`.
hints.en: `is_valid` is the same function as in Problem Set 2; what changes is the end of the file: `main()` under `if __name__ == "__main__":` instead of a bare `main()`.

hints.tr: Noktalama şartını rakamsız bir plakayla da dene (`CS 50`, `CS.50`): `PI3.14`'ü rakam kuralı da yakalıyor.
hints.en: Try the punctuation rule with a plate whose punctuation comes before the numbers too (`CS 50`, `CS.50`): the number rule catches `PI3.14` as well.

bug.en: plates longer than 6 characters count as valid.

bug.tr: tek harfle başlayan plakalar (`C50`) geçerli sayılıyor.
bug.en: plates starting with one letter (`C50`) count as valid.
punctuation and spaces are not checked (`CS 50` is valid).
the first number can be 0 (`CS05` is valid).
letters can follow numbers (`AAA22A` is valid).
